summary: Tested MFA 2FA flows (super_admin mandatory MFA, verify-mfa, request-mfa-code, toggle-mfa, /me endpoint) and Team Intelligence date filter (UI + API). All 12 backend tests pass, all 5 UI test scenarios pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MFA 2FA flows fully tested and working. Super admin login requires MFA (returns requires_mfa:true, mfa_session, no token). verify-mfa with wrong code returns 401. verify-mfa with invalid session JWT returns 401 with 'Session expired'. request-mfa-code returns 200 for admin/manager. toggle-mfa with wrong code returns 401. /me does NOT expose mfa_code/mfa_code_expires_at/mfa_code_attempts, DOES expose mfa_enabled. UI: MFA OTP screen shown for super_admin, back button works, Settings Security tab has Enable 2FA button, clicking it shows mfa-confirm-code-input. Team Intelligence date filter: insights-date-from and insights-date-to present in toolbar, Refresh reloads matrix. Admin login returns token directly (no MFA).
